name: Chthonic-Architrave
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by solar wind erosion patterns near the terminator.
The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Whoever abandoned ancient alien ruins did so in order: power first, then data, then people. The airlocks were cycled from the inside, gently, one last time.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
